updateserver.name: QuickFig
updateserver.desc: Your WordPress settings without editing wp-config.php: the site address, debugging, security, memory, updates and scheduled tasks, with rescue tools for a site that broke, the cache, maintenance mode and own tools of a Magento shop, a switch to https, reminders when debug mode is left on or a site is stuck in maintenance, and a crawler blocker (bad bots, scrapers posing as an old Chrome, robots.txt).
